info: Set Checkpoint 4 in the game's operator NVRAM. Applied at startup when NVRAM Settings (Service Menu) is enabled. Time extension in seconds, from 5 to 99.

label: Motion Angle
info: Set Motion Angle in the game's operator NVRAM. Applied at startup when NVRAM Settings (Service Menu) is enabled. Native cabinet motion limit in degrees; this does not calibrate the controls.

label: Internal Resolution
info: Select the internal rendering resolution to balance image quality and GPU load. Changes apply when returning to the game without a reset.

label: 3D Texture Filtering
info: Select the texture-sampling filter used by the 3D renderer. Uses the emulator's native Nearest, Bilinear or Trilinear filtering. Changes apply when returning to the game without a reset. If a filter shader is unavailable, the renderer uses the next supported filter.

label: Aspect Ratio
info: Select the displayed aspect ratio. Auto follows Widescreen Mode. Explicit 4:3 suppresses expansion; 16:9 or 16:10 with Widescreen Mode Disabled stretches the original image. Changes apply when returning to the game without a reset.

label: Widescreen Mode
info: Expand the 3D field of view using native per-game geometry and layer rules. Requires Aspect Ratio Auto, 16:9 or 16:10; explicit 4:3 suppresses expansion. Auto reports 16:9 when enabled. Disabled preserves Aspect Ratio and original rendering. Changes apply when returning to the game without a reset.

label: A/V Timing (Restart Required)
info: Select the video cadence and corresponding audio timing. 60 Hz adapts native audio to the frontend cadence using the SM2-Emu interpolation policy; 58 Hz preserves the cadence declared by Model2EmuEx. Each callback still executes one complete native machine frame. Applies after closing and reloading content.

label: Timing / FPS Overlay
info: Display 61-frame averages for machine, video, audio/pacing, retro_run and worst-frame time, plus actual frontend cadence and estimated processing capacity. Auto uses 13 px. CPU wall times include graphics submission, not GPU execution queries. Applies on return to the game without a reset.

label: Pipeline
info: Emulate the next frame on another processor core while rendering the previous frame. Enabled can improve performance on multi-core systems, at the cost of one extra frame of video latency (about 17 ms). Disabled emulates and renders in turn for lower latency. Changes apply when returning to the game without a reset.

label: Frame Skip
info: Skip drawing when the frontend reports an imminent audio underrun, at most two frames in a row. Emulation, sound and inputs continue. If audio-buffer status is unavailable, frames are not skipped. Applies on return to the game without a reset.

label: Shadows And Fences
info: Select native mesh transparency: Blend draws 50% transparency; Checker preserves the hardware checkerboard. Changes apply on return to the game without a reset.

label: Saturation
info: Adjust native colour saturation from 0.50 to 2.00. 1.00 preserves native colours. Changes apply on return to the game without a reset.

label: Gamma (Red)
info: Adjust the native red-channel brightness curve from 0.50 to 2.00. Above 1.00 brightens mid-tones; below 1.00 darkens them. Applies on return to the game without a reset.

label: Gamma (Green)
info: Adjust the native green-channel brightness curve from 0.50 to 2.00. Above 1.00 brightens mid-tones; below 1.00 darkens them. Applies on return to the game without a reset.

label: Gamma (Blue)
info: Adjust the native blue-channel brightness curve from 0.50 to 2.00. Above 1.00 brightens mid-tones; below 1.00 darkens them. Applies on return to the game without a reset.

label: Manx TT: Cabinet Audio
info: Select cabinet-appropriate sound ROMs and the additional sound board based on the selected cabinet configuration.

label: SCSP Gain
info: Adjust the SCSP sound source. Auto preserves the emulator's native mix. Mute silences this source while emulation continues. Applies on return to the game without a reset. Has no effect on boards without this sound source.

label: MultiPCM 1 Gain
info: Adjust the first MultiPCM sound source. Auto preserves the emulator's native mix. Mute silences this source while emulation continues. Applies on return to the game without a reset. Has no effect on boards without this sound source.

label: MultiPCM 2 Gain
info: Adjust the second MultiPCM sound source. Auto preserves the emulator's native mix. Mute silences this source while emulation continues. Applies on return to the game without a reset. Has no effect on boards without this sound source.

label: FM (YM3438) Gain
info: Adjust the YM3438 FM sound source. Auto preserves the emulator's native mix. Mute silences this source while emulation continues. Applies on return to the game without a reset. Has no effect on boards without this sound source.

label: Controller Profile Type
info: Select whether controller profiles include Test/Service inputs while retaining gameplay controls and remapping.

label: Gamepad Rumble
info: Enable gamepad vibration using the game's force-feedback or rumble effects.

label: Show Crosshair
info: Select external crosshair visibility for each player, or use the automatic native-reticle behavior.

label: Crosshair Style
info: Select the crosshair shape. Auto uses a custom PNG or SM2-Emu; Custom requires a PNG and reports missing artwork. PNGs: system/model2emuex/crosshairs/game-p1.png, game-p2.png or game.png; parent and default names are fallbacks. Maximum 1024 x 1024. Reload content after changing PNGs.

label: Crosshair Inactivity Timeout
info: Hide each player's external crosshair after the selected time without aiming or firing. Movement or a gun action shows it again. Disabled keeps the selected visibility. Has no effect on native game reticles.

label: Gun Input Mode
info: Select which input devices control the aiming cursor, including combined and dedicated input modes.

label: Gun Analog Stick Control
info: Select relative cursor movement or absolute-position aiming for the analog stick in gun games. Absolute returns to the centre when the stick is released; Mouse and Lightgun remain available in combined input modes. Changes apply immediately.

label: Off-Screen Reload Shortcut
info: Enable dedicated inputs that force an off-screen reload while retaining native lightgun off-screen firing.

label: Mouse Edge Off-Screen Reload
info: Allow a mouse shot at the screen edge to trigger off-screen reload.

label: 4-Speed Shifter
info: Select direct directional gear selection or diagonal analog-stick H-gate shifting. Applies only to 4-speed driving games.

label: Gear Shift Neutral Time
info: Set the time spent in neutral between gears when using Shift Up/Down in 4-speed driving games. Direct gear selection bypasses the delay. 0 disables it. Applies to subsequent shifts on return to gameplay without a machine reset; 0 also cancels a pending delay.

label: Automatic Start Gear (Restart Required)
info: Use the declared initial gear for rolling starts instead of always starting in first gear. Applies only to 4-speed driving games.

label: Driving Steering Response
info: Select the steering response curve to adjust sensitivity around the center while retaining full travel.

label: Driving Steering Output Range
info: Scale steering output around its center to adjust the input travel needed for full lock.

label: Driving Accelerator Output Range
info: Scale accelerator output from its released position to adjust the input travel needed for full acceleration.

label: Driving Brake Output Range
info: Scale brake output from its released position to adjust the input travel needed for full braking.

label: Desert Tank: Elevation Control
info: Select relative movement or absolute-position control for turret elevation.

label: Desert Tank: Elevation Speed (Relative Only)
info: Adjust the maximum turret elevation speed in relative control mode.

label: Desert Tank: Elevation Axis Mode
info: Select normal or inverted vertical input for turret elevation.
